test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 16 June 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: If 3rd February 2015 was a Tuesday, what was the day of the week on 6th June 2015?
solution:
No of days from 3rd February 2015 to 6th June 2015 =** 25 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 6 **= **123** as 2015 is a non-leap year.

Since, it was Tuesday on 3rd February 2015, every 7th day from 3rd February will be a Tuesday.

Thus, no. of odd days = 123/7 =** 4**

Now, 3rd February 2015 (Tuesday) + **4** odd days = 6th June 2015 (Saturday)

6th June 2015 will be Saturday.

Hence, "option 4" is the correct answer.
